mechanism_narrative: A high level of real GDP (GDPC1) relative to its 5-year moving average indicates robust economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings growth and investor confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 exceeds its 5-year moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid acceleration in inflation (CPIAUCSL increasing by more than 0.2 percentage points over three months) signals potential central bank tightening, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises > 0.2pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), the Federal Reserve's policy rate hikes increase borrowing costs and reduce corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing activity, which supports near-term corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO exceeds its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5.0% signals a tight labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE falls below 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) and a stable or rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS >= 0.5%) indicates persistent inflationary pressures without accommodative monetary policy, increasing recession risk and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS >= 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (as indicated by rising housing starts, HOUST), the economy nears full capacity, supporting strong consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is rising and the economy is in a late-cycle expansion.
